name: Airbnb AI Automation Suite - Omnichannel AI Agent

parameters.jsCode: const q=$json.query||$json; const expected=$env.META_VERIFY_TOKEN||''; if(q['hub.mode']==='subscribe'&&q['hub.verify_token']&&q['hub.verify_token']===expected){return [{json:{challenge:String(q['hub.challenge']||'')}}]}; throw new Error('Meta webhook verification failed');

const b=$json.body||$json,v=b.entry?.[0]?.changes?.[0]?.value||{},m=v.messages?.[0]||{},c=v.contacts?.[0]||{}; const t=m.text?.body||m.button?.text||m.interactive?.button_reply?.title||m.interactive?.list_reply?.title||''; return [{json:{channel:'whatsapp',senderId:m.from||c.wa_id||'',recipientId:v.metadata?.phone_number_id||'',messageId:m.id||'',text:String(t||''),sessionId:`whatsapp:${m.from||c.wa_id||''}`,raw:b}}];

const b=$json.body||$json,e=b.entry?.[0]||{},m=e.messaging?.[0]||b.messaging?.[0]||{},msg=m.message||{}; return [{json:{channel:'instagram',senderId:m.sender?.id||'',recipientId:m.recipient?.id||'',messageId:msg.mid||'',text:String(msg.text||msg.quick_reply?.payload||''),sessionId:`instagram:${m.sender?.id||''}`,raw:b}}];

const b=$json.body||$json,v=b.entry?.[0]?.changes?.[0]?.value||{},id=v.leadgen_id||b.leadgen_id||''; return [{json:{channel:'meta_ads',leadgenId:id,pageId:v.page_id||b.page_id||'',formId:v.form_id||b.form_id||'',sessionId:`meta_ads:${id}`,text:'New Meta Ads lead. Retrieve lead details and qualify for a property booking.',raw:b}}];

const base=$('Normalize Meta Ads Lead').first().json,d=$json,fields={}; for(const f of (d.field_data||[]))fields[f.name]=(f.values||[])[0]??''; return [{json:{...base,lead:{...fields,created_time:d.created_time||'',ad_id:d.ad_id||''},text:`Meta Ads lead details: ${JSON.stringify(fields)}. Qualify this guest and move toward a reservation.`}}];

const j=$json,c={channel:j.channel,senderId:j.senderId||'',recipientId:j.recipientId||'',sessionId:j.sessionId||'',messageId:j.messageId||'',lead:j.lead||null,userMessage:String(j.text||'').trim()}; return [{json:{...j,agentPrompt:`You are the Airbnb Booking AI Agent. Act as sales, concierge and support. Use tools for live data/actions; never invent availability, prices, booking IDs, policies or amenities. Convert qualified enquiries into confirmed bookings. Channel=${j.channel}. Guest context=${JSON.stringify(c)}. Return ONLY valid JSON with keys intent,reply,booking_status,lead_stage,needs_human,property_id,check_in,check_out,guests,booking_id. booking_status=enquiry|availability_checked|awaiting_payment|booked|support|cancelled. For booking: check availability first; create booking only after explicit confirmation and complete required details. Use only payment links returned by tools. Escalate refunds, emergencies, policy exceptions, uncertainty.`}}];

options.systemMessage: You are the central Airbnb AI Booking Agent. You understand Hindi, Hinglish, English and other Indian languages. Use tools instead of guessing. Never expose internal APIs. Always return the JSON schema requested by the user prompt.

parameters.toolDescription: Check live availability and price before promising anything.
Search matching properties by dates, guests, budget and preferences.
Create a reservation only after explicit guest confirmation and complete details.
Create/update the CRM lead record for this guest conversation.
Create an operational support ticket for issues needing staff.
Escalate to a human host/manager for refunds, emergencies, exceptions or uncertainty.

parameters.jsCode: const raw=String($json.output||$json.text||'').trim();let d;try{d=JSON.parse(raw)}catch(e){const m=raw.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);if(m){try{d=JSON.parse(m[0])}catch(_){}}}if(!d)d={intent:'support',reply:raw||'Sorry, I could not process that request.',booking_status:'support',lead_stage:'needs_human',needs_human:true};const o=$('Build Unified Agent Context').first().json;return [{json:{...o,...d,reply:String(d.reply||''),channel:o.channel,senderId:o.senderId||'',recipientId:o.recipientId||'',sessionId:o.sessionId||''}}];
const phone=$json.lead?.phone||$json.lead?.whatsapp||'';return [{json:{...$json,leadPhone:String(phone).replace(/[^0-9]/g,''),metaLeadReply:$json.reply}}];

const x=$input.first().json.body ?? $input.first().json;
return [{json:{call_id:x.call_id||x.id||`call_${Date.now()}`,guest_phone:x.phone||x.from||null,transcript:x.transcript||x.text||"",intent:x.intent||"unknown",property_id:x.property_id||null,priority:x.priority||"normal",raw:x}}];

const x=$input.first().json;
return [{json:{...x,prompt:`Classify this vacation-rental guest call. Return STRICT JSON keys intent,priority,reply,needs_human. Never invent policy. Transcript: ${x.transcript}`}}];

const data=$input.first().json; const rows=Array.isArray(data)?data:(data.leads||data.data||[]);
return rows.map(x=>({json:{lead_id:x.lead_id||x.id,phone:x.phone,message_context:x.message_context||x.last_message||"",property_id:x.property_id||null,dates:x.dates||null,price:x.price??null,prompt:`Write one concise follow-up for a vacation-rental lead. Do not invent availability, urgency, discounts, or price. Context: ${x.message_context||""}. Dates: ${JSON.stringify(x.dates||null)}. Price: ${x.price??"unknown"}.`}}));

return [{json:{lead_id:$('Build Follow-up Messages1').item.json.lead_id,phone:$('Build Follow-up Messages1').item.json.phone,message:$input.first().json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||"Hi! Just checking if you still need help with your stay."}}];

const d=$input.first().json; const rows=Array.isArray(d)?d:(d.properties||d.data||[]);
return rows.map(x=>({json:{property_id:x.property_id||x.id,current_price:x.current_price,occupancy:x.occupancy,upcoming_bookings:x.upcoming_bookings||[],local_events:x.local_events||[],comps:x.comps||[],prompt:`Act as a vacation-rental revenue analyst. Return STRICT JSON keys recommended_price,reason,confidence,action. Only recommend a price if current data supports it; never invent competitor prices. Data: ${JSON.stringify(x)}`}}));

let c=$input.first().json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||"{}";let a;try{a=JSON.parse(c)}catch(e){a={recommended_price:null,reason:"AI parse failure",confidence:0,action:"human_review"}};
return [{json:{property_id:$('Build Pricing Prompt1').item.json.property_id,current_price:$('Build Pricing Prompt1').item.json.current_price,recommendation:a,requires_approval:true}}];

const x=$input.first().json.body ?? $input.first().json;
return [{json:{review_id:x.review_id||x.id||`review_${Date.now()}`,property_id:x.property_id||null,guest_name:x.guest_name||"Guest",rating:Number(x.rating||0),review:x.review||x.text||"",source:x.source||"airbnb"}}];

const x=$input.first().json; return [{json:{...x,prompt:`Analyze this vacation-rental review. Return STRICT JSON keys sentiment,issues,praise,reply,staff_action. Be professional, never argue, never admit liability, and do not expose private guest data. Rating: ${x.rating}. Review: ${x.review}`}}];

let c=$input.first().json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content||"{}";let a;try{a=JSON.parse(c)}catch(e){a={sentiment:"unknown",issues:["parse_failure"],praise:[],reply:c,staff_action:"human_review"}};
const x=$('Normalize Review1').first().json; return [{json:{...x,ai:a,needs_staff_review:x.rating<=3||a.staff_action==="human_review"}}];
